limitations: Synthetic chat-only subset; this does not qualify the 50-case corpus.
Owner preference and quality review were not collected.

Memory, domain tools, Open WebUI, coding/action and production parity were not measured; pantry/weekend prompts intentionally run without their required data/tools to inspect graceful limitation handling.
The HADES-only overlay instruction changes the model request; that is part of the measured product tax.

Source script working-tree hash was not captured for this baseline; the before/after response behavior is reproduced and recorded, but exact harness reconstruction relies on the campaign worktree history.
capture_note: Before the workspace-off model-first repair. HADES returned a static workspace-disabled response for core-08 turn 2 in all three repetitions. The committed source_revision identifies the code base, while this exploratory harness was uncommitted during capture.
